description: This file implements an OCR transformation class for Mistral OCR within a larger system, providing configuration, request transformation, and response handling methods.

classes.name: MistralOCRConfig

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
